Now the question is what she's entitled to know: the legacy export mentions a "P. Shah-Mehta" with a different end date and flat, which looks like a separate person entirely, so I should rely on CRM as the authoritative source and flag the legacy record as needing correction rather than using it. No write actions seem necessary beyond logging the call and leaving notes — I'll log the call, add a note flagging the phone number mismatch so contact details get confirmed next time, and add a note correcting the legacy Fixflo record since it appears to reference a different tenant. I'll run these tool calls together to wrap this up efficiently.

Add a note to the tenant record that the caller's number differs from the number on file, to confirm the preferred number at the next contact.
